title: NBA Daily News Digest
subtitle: Preseason Wraps Up, GM Survey Released Ahead of Regular Season Tip-Off

items.headline: Wemby Projected MVP, DPOY; Spurs Favored for Title in GM Survey
items.summary: In a pre-season General Manager survey released today, San Antonio Spurs phenom Victor Wembanyama received significant backing to win both the MVP and Defensive Player of the Year awards for the upcoming 2026-27 season. The Spurs themselves were narrowly picked over the OKC Thunder to lift the NBA championship trophy.

items.headline: Celtics Edge 76ers in Overtime Thriller
items.summary: The Boston Celtics completed their preseason undefeated, overcoming the Philadelphia 76ers in an exciting 125-120 overtime victory. Joel Embiid led the Sixers with 27 points and 8 rebounds in 29 minutes.

items.headline: Nuggets Top Lakers in Preseason Finale
items.summary: Jamal Murray's 21 points helped the Denver Nuggets secure a 121-106 preseason win over the Los Angeles Lakers. Demar DeRozan added 14 points off the bench for Denver.

items.headline: Warriors Defeat Trail Blazers
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors defeated the Portland Trail Blazers 128-118 in their final preseason matchup. Deni Avdija contributed 12 points for the Blazers.

items.headline: Jazz Hold Off Suns
items.summary: The Utah Jazz secured a narrow 119-116 victory over the Phoenix Suns.

items.headline: Bulls Dominate Timberwolves
items.summary: The Chicago Bulls put on an offensive display, beating the Minnesota Timberwolves 133-116.

items.headline: Pelicans Edge Wizards in Tight Contest
items.summary: The New Orleans Pelicans narrowly defeated the Washington Wizards 107-106.

items.headline: Hawks Fly Past Mavericks
items.summary: The Atlanta Hawks secured a convincing 135-111 win against the Dallas Mavericks.

items.headline: Spurs Rout Kings
items.summary: The San Antonio Spurs delivered a dominant performance, defeating the Sacramento Kings 128-97.

items.headline: Grizzlies Handle Hornets
items.summary: The Memphis Grizzlies defeated the Charlotte Hornets 117-98.

items.headline: Bucks Win OT Thriller Against Pacers
items.summary: The Milwaukee Bucks narrowly escaped with a 128-127 overtime victory over the Indiana Pacers.

items.headline: Deni Avdija Leads Blazers in Attempts Against Warriors
items.summary: Portland Trail Blazers forward Deni Avdija finished with 12 points (5-15 FGs), 4 rebounds, 3 assists, 2 steals, and 1 block in Friday's exhibition against the Golden State Warriors, leading the Blazers' starters in shot attempts. Avdija has had a strong preseason overall, including a 26-point, 9-rebound, 4-assist, 2-block performance against the Kings, and previously 23 points against the Warriors.

items.headline: Ben Simmons Shows Flashes in Preseason Matchup vs. Spurs
items.summary: Highlights from Ben Simmons' recent preseason game against the San Antonio Spurs have been released, showcasing his playmaking and scoring as he prepares for the regular season.

items.headline: Blockbuster Offseason Moves Reshape Contender Landscape
items.summary: The NBA offseason saw monumental shifts in star power, with LeBron James notably joining the Philadelphia 76ers and Giannis Antetokounmpo taking his talents to the Miami Heat. These moves are expected to significantly impact the championship race for the upcoming season.

items.headline: Lakers' Collin Sexton Hopeful for Season Opener After Missing Preseason Finale
items.summary: Lakers guard Collin Sexton missed Friday's preseason finale but is reportedly progressing well and remains optimistic about being ready for the regular season opener next week.
